_comment: Discord webhooks. Copy this file to config/webhooks.json and fill in real URLs.
Each entry needs 'url' and 'tags'. Entries missing either are skipped, which is
why this documentation block is ignored by the loader rather than breaking it.
url     - the full Discord webhook URL for the target channel.
tags    - which event types get sent here. One webhook may carry several.
mention - OPTIONAL. Prepended to the message as '<mention>: ...', so put a
Discord role mention here to ping that role, e.g. '<@&123456789>'.
Use '@here' or '@everyone' only if you really mean it.
Available tags (see code/__DEFINES/webhook.dm):
admin_log        - every admin log line (needs EXPORT_ADMIN_LOG_TO_DISCORD).
law_enforcement  - First Responder enforcement actions only: repossessions,
force-stashes, scuttlings, schematic withdrawals and
stolen-flag clearing. Intended for a security channel that
should NOT see the whole admin log.
g_apm            - admin PMs.
g_apm_a          - admin PMs flagged important.
g_admin          - adminhelps.
g_admin_a        - adminhelps flagged important.
cciaa_emergency  - CCIAA emergency messages.
alert_noadmins   - round started with no admins online.
roundstart       - round start announcement.
roundend         - round end announcement.
